scripts.check:repo: node scripts/validate-spec-lifecycle.mjs && biome check . && pnpm --filter @openkit/models-dev-catalog test
scripts.test:unit: turbo run test && node --test tests/story-runner/*.test.mjs tests/release-preflight.test.mjs tests/spec-lifecycle.test.mjs
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm --filter @openkit/nanocore build && node tests/smoke/nanocore-health-smoke.mjs && pnpm --filter @openkit/web build && node tests/smoke/web-preview-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:stories:deterministic: node --test tests/story-runner/*.test.mjs && pnpm run test:stories:mcp && pnpm --filter @openkit/web e2e:stories
scripts.test:stories:mcp: pnpm --filter @openkit/app-api-schemas build && pnpm --filter @openkit/core-client build && pnpm --filter @openkit/mcp build && pnpm --filter @openkit/nanocore build && node tests/story-runner/goal-mode-mcp-smoke-runner.mjs && node tests/story-runner/task-mode-mcp-smoke-runner.mjs && node tests/story-runner/chat-mode-mcp-smoke-runner.mjs && node tests/story-runner/workspace-portability-mcp-runner.mjs && node tests/story-runner/recovery-mcp-smoke-runner.mjs
scripts.verify:l0-l2: pnpm run check:repo && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm build
scripts.verify:release: pnpm run verify:l0-l2 && pnpm run test:e2e:nano && pnpm run test:smoke
scripts.verify:full: pnpm run verify:l0-l2 && pnpm run test:e2e:nano && pnpm run test:e2e:web && pnpm run test:smoke && pnpm run test:stories
